$comment: AILGEN Lab's paid models: every one is billed from the AI Gateway credits (Unified Billing) through the gateway in surfaces.json (LAB_GATEWAY). Ids, inputs and prices are from each model's page in the Cloudflare catalog (developers.cloudflare.com/ai/models/<id>/), checked 2026-10-01. The real cost of each call comes from the gateway's log; the numbers here are for the estimate shown before a run. Credits cost 5% more than their face value ($100 of credits = $105).
